name: The Ritz-Carlton, Half Moon Bay
positioning: Shingle-style oceanfront resort on a bluff in Half Moon Bay, California, with two golf courses and a spa
best_for: Golfers who want two courses at the resort
Travelers who want a coastal resort stay with fire pits and a spa

facts.text: The resort sits on a bluff overlooking the ocean, about 20 miles from San Francisco International Airport.
The Ocean Course was designed by Arthur Hills in a traditional Scottish style that follows the natural terrain of the Northern California coast.
The Old Course was originally designed by Francis Duane and Arnold Palmer in 1973 and redesigned by Arthur Hills in 1999.
The resort has three restaurants: Navio, The Conservatory and Ocean Terrace.
Ocean Terrace serves seafood outdoors with ocean views and fire pits.
The spa's signature treatments include the Redwood Forest Ritual, and it offers seasonal facials using locally sourced ingredients.
The Luxury Fire Pit Suite is a ground-level suite with a private fire pit and a fireplace in the bedroom.
The resort has a glass-enclosed, heated indoor pool with an atrium-style setting.
The hotel's Shingle style architecture was chosen to blend the building into the coast's asymmetrical landscape.
The resort holds a 2026 Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star Award.
Navio received a Forbes Travel Guide Four Star Award for 2026.

highlights.text: The Ocean Course was designed by Arthur Hills in a traditional Scottish style that follows the natural terrain of the Northern California coast.
The Old Course is a parkland-style course whose home hole plays next to the ocean, with cypress-lined fairways.
The Luxury Fire Pit Suite is a ground-level suite with a private fire pit and a fireplace in the bedroom.
A bagpiper plays on the cliffs around sunset.
The Farm-to-Table Discovery experience is a chef-guided tour of Brisa Ranch, one of the resort's local purveyors.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the remote coastal location means driving to reach nearby attractions.
Guest House rooms are in residential-style buildings about an eight-minute walk from the main building.
In-house guests without a confirmed spa reservation can use the spa amenities with a day pass costing $65 USD per person per day.
